evidence: A home improver with limited time and working space calls CutList Optimizer the only tool they have relied on and argues paper plus simpler planning often beats CAD for hobby projects.

evidence_sources.author: itissid
evidence_sources.excerpt: I do home improvement projects (I've in wall built-in storage, benches and nooks) I am on a clock and i have very little room in which to work. The only tool I have relied on https://www.cutlistoptimizer.com/

source_story_title: Ask HN: CAD for wood working with LLM support?
